احتقرتم (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَرْتُمْ (iḥtaqartum) /iħ.ta.qar.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# اُحْتُقِرْتُمْ (uḥtuqirtum) /uħ.tu.qir.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
